# PostgreSQL
> The official site for PostgreSQL, the world's most advanced open source database.

PostgreSQL.org is the primary source for PostgreSQL downloads, official documentation, release notes, community resources, developer information, support options, and project governance.

## Core Site
- [Home](https://www.postgresql.org/): Main portal for PostgreSQL releases, news, events, and project resources.
- [About PostgreSQL](https://www.postgresql.org/about/): Overview of the PostgreSQL project, history, governance, and capabilities.
- [Download](https://www.postgresql.org/download/): Download PostgreSQL packages, installers, and source code for supported platforms.
- [Documentation](https://www.postgresql.org/docs/): Official manuals for current and previous PostgreSQL releases.
- [Community](https://www.postgresql.org/community/): Community hubs including mailing lists, events, IRC, and local groups.
- [Developers](https://www.postgresql.org/developer/): Resources for PostgreSQL contributors, source code, and development workflow.
- [Support](https://www.postgresql.org/support/): Commercial support, community help channels, and professional services listings.
- [Your Account](https://www.postgresql.org/account/): Account area for community services and site-related access.

## Documentation
- [Documentation Home](https://www.postgresql.org/docs/): Entry point to all PostgreSQL manuals and versioned documentation.
- [Current Documentation](https://www.postgresql.org/docs/current/): Official manual for the latest PostgreSQL release.
- [Documentation Archive](https://www.postgresql.org/docs/): Access manuals for supported and older PostgreSQL versions.
- [Release Notes](https://www.postgresql.org/docs/current/release.html): Detailed release notes for the current PostgreSQL major version.
- [Tutorial](https://www.postgresql.org/docs/current/tutorial.html): Introductory tutorial covering basic PostgreSQL concepts and SQL usage.
- [SQL Command Reference](https://www.postgresql.org/docs/current/sql-commands.html): Reference for PostgreSQL SQL statements and command syntax.
- [Server Administration](https://www.postgresql.org/docs/current/admin.html): Administration topics including configuration, backup, replication, and monitoring.
- [Client Interfaces](https://www.postgresql.org/docs/current/client-interfaces.html): Documentation for libpq, embedded SQL, and language interfaces.

## Downloads and Releases
- [Download PostgreSQL](https://www.postgresql.org/download/): Platform-specific download options and package repositories.
- [Source Code](https://www.postgresql.org/download/source/): Official source tarballs and source download information.
- [Linux Downloads](https://www.postgresql.org/download/linux/): Distribution-specific PostgreSQL packages and repository instructions for Linux.
- [macOS Downloads](https://www.postgresql.org/download/macosx/): macOS installation options and package sources.
- [Windows Downloads](https://www.postgresql.org/download/windows/): Windows installers and package options for PostgreSQL.
- [Versioning Policy](https://www.postgresql.org/support/versioning/): PostgreSQL version support policy, release cadence, and lifecycle details.
- [Latest News](https://www.postgresql.org/about/news/): Official release announcements, project news, and security updates.

## Learn and Get Started
- [About PostgreSQL](https://www.postgresql.org/about/): High-level introduction to PostgreSQL features, values, and project background.
- [What is PostgreSQL?](https://www.postgresql.org/about/): Overview of PostgreSQL as an open source relational database.
- [Feature Matrix](https://www.postgresql.org/about/featurematrix/): Searchable matrix of PostgreSQL features across versions.
- [Feature Matrix Detail](https://www.postgresql.org/about/featurematrix/detail/): Detailed pages for individual PostgreSQL features and support status.
- [Documentation Tutorial](https://www.postgresql.org/docs/current/tutorial.html): Beginner-friendly walkthrough for creating tables and running queries.
- [Learning Opportunities](https://www.postgresql.org/community/): Community entry point for events, groups, and educational resources.

## Community
- [Community Home](https://www.postgresql.org/community/): Overview of PostgreSQL community programs, communication channels, and participation.
- [Mailing Lists](https://www.postgresql.org/list/): Official mailing lists for users, developers, announcements, and support.
- [Events](https://www.postgresql.org/about/event/): Calendar of PostgreSQL conferences, meetups, and community events.
- [Local User Groups](https://www.postgresql.org/community/user-groups/): Directory of PostgreSQL user groups around the world.
- [IRC](https://www.postgresql.org/community/irc/): IRC channels for PostgreSQL discussion and real-time community help.
- [Planet PostgreSQL](https://www.postgresql.org/community/planetpostgresql/): Aggregated blog posts from PostgreSQL community members.
- [Community Recognition](https://www.postgresql.org/community/contributors/): Recognition of contributors and community participants.

## News and Events
- [News Archive](https://www.postgresql.org/about/news/): Official PostgreSQL news posts, release announcements, and project updates.
- [Events Calendar](https://www.postgresql.org/about/event/): Browse upcoming PostgreSQL conferences, talks, and training events.
- [PostgreSQL 18.3, 17.9, 16.13, 15.17, and 14.22 Released!](https://www.postgresql.org/about/news/): Release announcement for multiple supported PostgreSQL branches.
- [PGConf.dev 2026 Schedule Announced!](https://www.postgresql.org/about/news/): Official announcement for the PostgreSQL development conference schedule.
- [Hyderabad Postgres Days 2026: Announcement and CFP/CFS](https://www.postgresql.org/about/news/): Community event announcement and call for participation.
- [Join Us at PGDay Armenia 2026 in Yerevan on April 30, 2026](https://www.postgresql.org/about/news/): Event promotion for a regional PostgreSQL conference.
- [Greenmask 0.2.9 - 0.2.17 Releases](https://www.postgresql.org/about/news/): Community news item covering Greenmask releases.

## Developer Resources
- [Developer Home](https://www.postgresql.org/developer/): Starting point for PostgreSQL source development and contributor information.
- [Source Code](https://www.postgresql.org/download/source/): Obtain PostgreSQL source code for building and development.
- [Git Web Interface](https://git.postgresql.org/): Browse PostgreSQL source repositories and project commits.
- [CommitFest](https://commitfest.postgresql.org/): Track patches, reviews, and PostgreSQL development discussions.
- [Bug Reporting](https://www.postgresql.org/account/submitbug/): Submit PostgreSQL bug reports through the official reporting system.
- [Mailing Lists](https://www.postgresql.org/list/): Development and hackers mailing lists for design and patch discussion.
- [Developer FAQ](https://wiki.postgresql.org/wiki/Developer_FAQ): Community-maintained answers for PostgreSQL contributors and developers.

## Support
- [Support Home](https://www.postgresql.org/support/): Overview of support channels for PostgreSQL users and organizations.
- [Professional Support](https://www.postgresql.org/support/professional_support/): Directory of companies offering PostgreSQL consulting and support.
- [Mailing Lists](https://www.postgresql.org/list/): Community support via user and administrator mailing lists.
- [IRC](https://www.postgresql.org/community/irc/): Real-time community support channels on IRC.
- [Documentation](https://www.postgresql.org/docs/): Official manuals for troubleshooting, administration, and SQL reference.
- [Versioning Policy](https://www.postgresql.org/support/versioning/): Determine support status and maintenance windows for PostgreSQL versions.
- [Security Information](https://www.postgresql.org/support/security/): Security policy, reporting guidance, and vulnerability information.

## Project Governance and Policies
- [About PostgreSQL](https://www.postgresql.org/about/): Project structure, organizations, and PostgreSQL background information.
- [Donate](https://www.postgresql.org/about/donate/): Donation information for supporting the PostgreSQL project.
- [Policies](https://www.postgresql.org/about/policies/): Site and project policies, trademarks, and legal information.
- [Code of Conduct](https://www.postgresql.org/about/policies/coc/): Community code of conduct for PostgreSQL spaces and events.
- [Contact](https://www.postgresql.org/about/contact/): Official contact information for PostgreSQL organizations and inquiries.
- [Contributing](https://www.postgresql.org/about/contributing/): Information about organizations and individuals contributing to PostgreSQL.
- [Core Team](https://www.postgresql.org/developer/core/): Information about the PostgreSQL Core Team and project leadership.
